reviewed_baseline.scope: Historical claim implementation review; not review or approval of this package.

case_rules.repeat_condition: Only after the first exact expected response and complete unchanged-state check; never after ambiguous transport or process failure.
case_rules.profile_rule: P/S are separately labeled negative stored-state fixtures under section 5.1; they are not valid positive ledger states or script-produced administrative success. A cases use the separate administrative profile.

shared_ledger_fixture.basis: claim_release.py:compile_fixture initial ready state and independent Go wire oracle
shared_ledger_fixture.setup_time: Observed Redis TIME T; positive ordinary fixture captured once before writes.
shared_ledger_fixture.ledger_acl: Exact claim-key-kinds-v1 selectors; no AUTH mutations, no absence-key content reads, no legacy/downstream EVALSHA keys.
shared_ledger_fixture.positive_control: PC01 on the same newly reviewed harness/image/source/ACL policy; historical PASS is supporting evidence only.
shared_ledger_fixture.stored_negative_setup: Apply only the row's closed delta while setup still owns its exact keys; verify every resulting byte/type/expiry and all declared absences, then revoke setup/loader/BOOT before measured calls. No later setup regrant or repair.
shared_ledger_fixture.observer: Read-only literal union, including bounded contents of negative-only markers; no mutation or credential administration.
shared_ledger_fixture.acl_regression: Repeat all 46 existing authority denials in P/S/W cases, with the case-specific whole-state oracle after every probe.

redis_cases.control: Refresh CR01-CR12 unchanged on the package's new artifacts before treating negatives as acceptance.

redis_cases.setup_delta: Add the case compatibility-marker hash at mifolyo:contracts:candidate; all other negative-only keys absent.
Add the canonical contract digest string at mifolyo:crawl:v2:contract:candidate; other negative-only keys absent.
Add one schema-valid case-bound admin_freeze hash at T; candidate pair absent. This is labeled invalid combined active state.
Omit active compatibility from initial setup, retaining the ordinary expected gate RECORD and all other entries.
Install active contract as a persistent single-field hash fixture_invalid=1 instead of its string.
Replace only the stored active-contract string with SHA256(package_id + ':other-contract'); require nonzero and distinct from canonical contract.
Store guard approved_at_ms=T-1 while the valid expected guard uses T; core digest and every other field unchanged; T>1.
Add only fixture_invalid=1 to the otherwise valid active compatibility hash; request RECORD unchanged.

redis_cases.sequence: Two definite rejections per wire mutation, unchanged ready state after each; then unmodified claim A and release A as same-instance positive controls; then 46 ACL probes.

Perform real persistence probe/restart and remove probe; revoke setup/loader; run BOOT input negatives against absent durability, then real-evidence OK and exact EXISTS_IDENTICAL; retire BOOT before final teardown. No run/job/authority setup.

wire_assertions.mutation: Set gate mode to candidate on otherwise unchanged CLAIM A.
Use a distinct valid 32-hex expected boot epoch.
Set expected contract digest to 64 zeros.
Empty only the expected guard RECORD.
Empty only the expected retirement RECORD.
Supply a schema-valid nonempty admin_freeze RECORD in an active gate.
Truncate the last byte of the compatibility RECORD.
Change expected contract to a distinct nonzero digest, retaining the original internally valid guard/compatibility records.
Swap one-based KEYS[44] job and KEYS[45] reservation; both keys retain outer ACL admission.
Replace KEYS[45] with the manifest-listed reservation B key while retaining every A argument; B is outer-ACL-admitted but not derivable for this request.
Remove the final transition_id argument and encode a well-framed RESP request with one fewer ARGV.

boot_assertions.mutation: Omit approval_mode from the eight-argument BOOT wire.
Set evidence digest to empty bytes.
Use captured Redis TIME minus 2592000001 ms; require positive result. Do not change the 2592000000 ms age constant.
Use captured Redis TIME plus 600000 ms, beyond the entire bounded case.
Submit the actual pre-restart Redis run ID instead of the observed current ID.
Replace epoch with exactly 32 uppercase G characters.
Set approval_mode to unknown-mode with both planned fields empty.

administrative_controls.inventory: 58-position privately derived worker namespace plus five exact legacy and eight downstream positions = 71 possible keys, all initially absent except canonical BOOT. Zero runs/jobs/claims/starts/outputs.
administrative_controls.ledger_role: Unchanged narrow claim-key-kinds-v1 command policy and 58-key EVALSHA union; do not add the five legacy or eight downstream keys or candidate content reads.
administrative_controls.setup_ownership: Setup writes only the temporary persistence probe. Candidate pair/freeze/retirement/active guard are produced only by canonical administrative calls, never copied from ledger_setup().
administrative_controls.prerequisite_evidence: Capture exact empty legacy/downstream/backlink inventory, bounded empty logical-backup artifact and stopped participant/process observations from this isolated case. Bind digests, freeze nonce, source and manifest before any admin call.
administrative_controls.sequence: BOOT/replay; revoke setup/loader/BOOT; run the listed canonical prefix under its separate admin roles; record full prestate; invoke the same valid target wire twice under ledger with no writes; invoke that exact target wire once under its admin role and verify its complete expected success state.
administrative_controls.nonvacuity: Independent Go constructor and in-memory canonical checks prove wire/preconditions. Real same-state/same-wire admin success is mandatory; a shape error, unrelated gate error, NOSCRIPT or generic REDIS_ERROR cannot count as the planned denial.
administrative_controls.acl_split: A01 admits all eight outer keys and reaches Plan.seal's denied authority HSET. A02/A03 intentionally fail Redis outer key admission on legacy/downstream positions; do not describe them as inner mutation preflight tests.
administrative_controls.admin_permissions: Compile per-case release_admin and migration_admin selectors from the finite source call traces. Release writes only the candidate pair/freeze and, for promotion, guard plus exact rename/unlink. Fresh retirement grants HSET only on retirement; no legacy deletion is needed for the zero-count control. No wildcard, category, ACL management or arbitrary EVAL/source loading grants.
administrative_controls.revocation: Retire release_admin immediately after its final required call and migration_admin immediately after retirement control/prefix; final cleanup proves all seven or eight case roles revoked without regrant.
administrative_controls.coverage_limit: Minimal fresh administrative success controls only; no migration-shaped conformance, full administrative replay matrix, operational promotion or release evidence.

offline_assertions.expectation: Closed compiler/approval rejection before connection or Docker mutation; valid pinned artifact remains the positive control.

BOOT_PROVENANCE rejection before BOOT EVALSHA by comparison with exact controller-observed probe/restart receipts. This is a proposed closed harness diagnostic, not a claim that Lua detects synthetic evidence.
Exact case-manifest rejection, zero unauthorized setup writes. Only the selected P/S delta is permitted; a malformed-state case must not disable normal validation.
VOLUME_EXISTS or earlier closed input rejection; no adoption, start or deletion of the preexisting object.

VOLUME_OWNER for wrong labels; planned VOLUME_SHARED for control/data aliasing or foreign attachment. Permit only the exact declared same-case role attachments, including the required private control-volume sharing. Foreign resources remain untouched; verify attachments before start and before cleanup ownership decisions.
VOLUME_NOT_EMPTY before writing configuration/ACL material or starting Redis.
ISOLATION with closed HostConfig check names; Dns/ExtraHosts admission checks must be added and tested, not presumed present.
NETWORK_INTERFACE, ACTIVE_INTERFACE, IPV4_ROUTE or IPV6_ROUTE respectively in the existing read-only network predicate.
IMAGE_PROXY or PROXY respectively, using synthetic environment fixtures.
ISOLATION HostConfig.Binds or MOUNTS exact inventory/type rejection; no real host or Docker socket is mounted in a negative test.
CONTAINER_IDENTITY or ISOLATION with the exact mutated check name; retain only the existing CHOWN/CAP_CHOWN singleton init equivalence.
IMAGE_IDENTITY, UNTRACKED_INPUT/DIRTY_INPUT, APPROVAL_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH, EXECUTION_NOT_APPROVED or APPROVAL_EXPIRY at their respective boundaries, before dispatch.

Planned CONTAINER_COMMAND, CONTAINER_ENV or PROCESS_INVENTORY rejection. Compare actual target metadata/process inventory to the closed reviewed role; use synthetic canaries, never production secrets/processes.
CREDENTIAL_REUSE, closed role-schema rejection or failed revocation/no-regrant assertion. Admin cases explicitly enumerate their extra roles.
PLAN_MISMATCH before dispatch or CONFIG/AOF/CLUSTER/REPLICATION/PRE_STAGE_MEMORY under injected read-only configuration observations. Never start deliberately unsafe Redis configuration.

common_assertions.scope: Complete inventory/types/bytes/indexes/counters/absolute expiry before and after each negative, with independent expected state and zero mutation delta; counter applicability explicit for no-job cases.
Exact intended rejection code/layer, verified source SHA loaded and nonvacuous positive controls; no generic error, transport failure or NOSCRIPT pass.
Exact immutable source/image/plan/recipe/setup/ACL/provenance identities, fixed case/assertion inventory and numeric observation fields; missing required receipt fails.
Bounded redacted controller journal and stage receipts on every exit; hard time limits, no ambiguous write retry and no lost-receipt success inference.

Actual executor stop/wait/PID-zero/removal before fresh revoker; all case roles including extra admins rejected on reconnect while Redis reachable; exact four-container/two-volume absence independently verified.

Offline/admission assertions retain their own evidence class and zero dispatch/start trace; a correctly rejected simulated controller run remains FAIL/case_evidence_valid=false, with only the enclosing admission assertion passing.

requirement_links.limit: Fresh positive controls only; migration and complete administrative matrix remain open.
